maria_mlinfra: did a wide sweep this morning across A100 / H100 / L40S for flash/fused/paged variants. seeing a reproducible tail latency spike when seq>=2048 and batch<=2 on H100 -- looks like KV spill + kernel fallback hotspot. attaching quick dump

ashok: can you paste the exact command + env? also which model and quant profile?

maria_mlinfra: command: `tools/bench/attn_sweep --gpus H100,A100,L40S --seq 256,512,1024,2048,4096 --batch 1,2,4 --kernels flash,fused,paged --model redwood-7b --quant int8`

maria_mlinfra: raw excerpt:
```
H100 seq=4096 batch=1 kernel=flash  p50=34ms p95=152ms p99=412ms  (kv_spill=true, fallback=paged)
H100 seq=4096 batch=1 kernel=fused  p50=30ms p95=98ms  p99=180ms  (kv_spill=false)
A100 seq=4096 batch=1 kernel=flash  p50=40ms p95=120ms p99=210ms  (kv_spill=false)
L40S seq=4096 batch=1 kernel=flash  p50=60ms p95=220ms p99=620ms  (kv_spill=true, fallback=fused)
```

luca: interesting that fused avoids the tail on H100. could be a kernel-specific alloc pattern that triggers GPU mem fragmentation + async copy blowup. did you capture NVTX traces?

maria_mlinfra: grabbed a quick nvprof + CUPTI slice for the H100 flash run. nvtx shows repeated cudaMemcpyAsync bursts during KV spill window. looks like spill path serializes extra memcpy for each kv-chunk.

benchbot: perf-check: artifacts uploaded -> s3://redwood-perf/2009999999/; summary.json -> PASS (regression=False) but note high-p99 on H100/flash for seq>=2048

ashok: can we repro with warm KV cache (no spill) vs cold? might be interaction with our prefetch heuristics.

maria_mlinfra: yes: warm-cache run (prefill kv) drops p99 to ~120ms for flash on H100. cold-cache triggers repeated spill and fallback to paged. so two issues: (1) flash spill path extra memcpy cost, (2) fallback policy triggers paged fallback which is even worse sometimes.

luca: propose short-term: change kernel selection policy for H100 to prefer fused for seq>=2048 when batch<=2, unless memory headroom is high. also add a KV spill coalescing patch to avoid per-chunk memcpy.

ashok: sounds reasonable. can you put an A/B rollout plan? want to avoid regressions on A100/L40S.

maria_mlinfra: plan in PR: 1) policy tweak gated by region/env flag 2) coalesce memcpy patch behind feature flag 3) perf smoke in CI for H100/A100/L40S seq=4096 batch=1/2 4) roll 5% -> 25% -> 100% in Dedicated.

ci-bot: created PR #4827: "kvspill: coalesce memcpy + h100 kernel policy" with perf regression tests. CI results: 18/20 checks green, two flaky infra timeouts retried. link: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood-inference/pulls/4827

ashok: add a microbenchmark that isolates memcpy cost (no compute) so we can see raw memcpy latency vs chunk size. also record CUDA occupancy + sm_efficiency for flash vs fused.

maria_mlinfra: added microbench to the PR and pushed nvtx profiles to the artifact bucket. next step: run a canary on one H100 pool tonight at 02:00 UTC. will post results in this thread. :rocket:
